correction: setup ran from the vendored copy - which is exactly how a colleague re-runs it after cloning, and what the docs tell them to type - aborted with shutil.SameFileError: .ci/lib is both the source and the destination of the vendor step, so copying a module onto itself is the normal case there, not an error. The crash landed after the config step and before the console was written, so the run looked half-done for no reason. Treat 'already in place' as success, and let the console templates travel with the runtime, because setup looks for the template next to itself and a clone has no copy of the skill.

proposed_skill_edit.change: Add the corrected behavior: setup must survive being re-run from the vendored copy - copying a module onto itself counts as already in place, and the console templates travel with the runtime.

regression_test.must_contain: setup has to survive being re-run from the vendored copy.

version.reason: Correction from real use; makes the documented re-run path work.
